reports.notes: Handwritten; the largest figures in this chunk. OFFICE DISAGREEMENT WITH THE PORTAL: index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat A' but the page's Office Seeking line reads only 'County Commissioner' with NO seat letter - the seat is not stated on the filing and was not inferred. TWO COLUMN-B CELLS LEFT BLANK by the filer (line 1 and line 2 Year-to-Date); they are '' and NOT zero. Cents are written as small raised pairs with a trailing flourish ('26,148.' + raised '25'; '21,549.' + raised '12'; '4599.' + raised '13') - medium confidence on the cents, high on the dollars. Line 7 is written without a thousands comma ('4599.13') unlike lines 1/2/4/5/6, and is transcribed as printed. Line 3 is a slashed-zero glyph. Summary page header reads 'Page 1 of 1' even though the PDF has 9 pages (Schedule A/B sheets follow).

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($26,148.25) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also the printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' on p5 (26,148.25)
contributions.detail: 36 rows across the two contribution ledgers sum to 26,148.25 exactly = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Column A. The page-subtotal gate closes twice, independently: the p4 attachment's 26 rows sum to 14,250.00 = its own handwritten 'subT. $14,250.00', and the p5 Schedule A page's 10 rows sum to 11,898.25 = its own printed 'Subtotal for this page'; 14,250.00 + 11,898.25 = 26,148.25. That double closure is also what settles the one overwritten amount (Raymond Beckham, read 500 or 600): only 500.00 makes the p4 subtotal, and arithmetic closure outranks the glyph. COLUMN B IS ENTIRELY BLANK on this filing (the filer entered no year-to-date figures at all), so no cumulative reading was available or needed - the anchor is the per-period cell, as the regime requires.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($21,549.12) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to the typed ledger's own 'Total' line on p9 (21549.12)
expenditures.detail: 67 rows across the three typed ledger pages sum to 21,549.12 exactly = the ledger's own printed Total = the cover's Column A. Per page: p7 26 rows = 9,168.89; p8 28 rows = 10,987.16; p9 13 rows = 1,393.07. Neither p7 nor p8 prints a page subtotal - the ledger totals once, on p9 - so the gate here is the grand total, and it closes to the cent. Column B YTD is blank, as on the contribution side. The p2 ladder is internally consistent: line 3 (a slashed zero) + line 4 (26,148.25) = line 5 (26,148.25); 26,148.25 - line 6 (21,549.12) = line 7 (4,599.13).

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable - no row on either ledger is marked in-kind and neither ledger prints an in-kind column, so the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind conventions give the identical sums (26,148.25 / 21,549.12) and both close on Column A. Both conventions were tested rather than inherited, because two other filings in this same chunk (Thompson 2010 x2) do fold in-kind into Column A.
itemized.escalation_note: (1) p4 row 9 (Raymond Beckham) - the amount is written over itself and reads 500 or 600 at any resolution; the page's own subtotal (14,250.00 less the other 25 rows = 500.00) decides it, and no glyph re-read was allowed to override that. (2) p4 row 10 - the surname is the least legible entry on the page and the month digit of its date is overwritten; a 700 dpi column crop gave 'Sherman Young' as the best reading, recorded at LOW confidence with needs_review=1 rather than asserted. (3) BAND IDENTIFICATION on three pages (p4, p7, p9): 900 dpi crops of the first detected band proved it to be a header row on p4 and p7, and on p9 proved the first rule to be the BOTTOM of row 1 (the band rendered the SECOND entry), so p9's row 1 was extrapolated one pitch up and re-proved. Without those crops every row index on those pages would have been off by one.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'Gary J Anderson' - index.csv names NO candidate for this row; the page face governs. Party 'Republican'; residence city Springville, UT (the cover prints a street address, deliberately not recorded). ⚠ OFFICE: the page face says only 'County Commissioner' - NO SEAT LETTER - while index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat A' from the acquisition channel's own path. The seat is NOT inferred onto the page face here; both facts are recorded and neither is adjudicated. THE LARGEST FILING IN THIS CHUNK and structurally the most complex: 9 pages, each classified from its own printed header - p1 COVER ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election' checked, amendment 'No', signed 6/15/10, clerk stamp JUN 15 PM 4:14), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (its own printed header; page box '1 of 1'), p3 SCHEDULE A form page ('1 of 3') carrying NO entries and no subtotal - only the filer's pointer 'See attached pages (2)', p4 the first contributions ATTACHMENT (a landscape, boxed, mostly handwritten grid headed 'CONTRIBUTIONS', hand-annotated 'Schedule A' and 'Page 1 of 2', ending in a handwritten 'subT. $14,250.00'), p5 a SECOND SCHEDULE A FORM PAGE ('2 of 2') with 10 entries, its own printed subtotal 11,898.25 and the grand 'Total Contributions Received' 26,148.25, p6 SCHEDULE B form page ('1 of 4') again carrying only the pointer 'See attached pages (3)', and p7-p9 the TYPED landscape expenditure ledger headed 'EXPENDITURES' with the campaign name 'Gary Anderson for Commissioner' written across the top of p7, ending in a 'Total' line of 21549.12 on p9. The two pointer pages (p3, p6) are counted as read and are the reason itemized_pages_A/B name the attachment pages instead: they are NOT empty schedules - the entries exist, on the attachments the filer refers to. SOURCE PROPERTY THIS BRIEF DID NOT ANTICIPATE: the filer's own attachment ledgers carry columns the county form does not - a separate Organization column and a Phone Number column on the contributions attachment, and a real Purpose/Items column on the expenditure ledger (which is why these expenditure rows carry `purpose` while every other filing in this chunk cannot). The expenditure attachment is also UNREDACTED and prints street addresses and phone numbers throughout; nothing of either is reproduced in this record. Column B (Year-to-Date) is BLANK on both summary lines - this filer reported no cumulative figures at all, which is a documented absence, not an unread cell.
